legacy_catalog_publications_confirmation.name: legacy_catalog_publications_confirmation_check
legacy_catalog_publications_confirmation.value: "legacy_catalog_publications"."status" in ('editing','review','blocked') or ("legacy_catalog_publications"."confirmed_at" is not null and "legacy_catalog_publications"."intent" is not null and "legacy_catalog_publications"."fingerprint" is not null and "legacy_catalog_publications"."expires_at" is not null)

legacy_product_recoveries_recovered_chec.name: legacy_product_recoveries_recovered_check
legacy_product_recoveries_recovered_chec.value: "legacy_product_recoveries"."status" <> 'recovered' or ("legacy_product_recoveries"."base_product_id" is not null and "legacy_product_recoveries"."user_id" is not null and "legacy_product_recoveries"."method" is not null)

store_brand_completed_check.name: store_brand_completed_check
store_brand_completed_check.value: "store_brand"."completed_at" is null or ("store_brand"."name" is not null and "store_brand"."description" is not null)

store_onboarding_completed_check.name: store_onboarding_completed_check
store_onboarding_completed_check.value: "store_onboarding"."completed_at" is null or "store_onboarding"."whatsapp" is not null

student_experiences_expert_check.name: student_experiences_expert_check
student_experiences_expert_check.value: "student_experiences"."expert" in ('pri','ze') and ("student_experiences"."manual_expert" is null or "student_experiences"."manual_expert" in ('pri','ze'))
